description: Actual full image: one upright young woman, short tight copper curl cap with clear head margin, hands relaxed together, brown footwear visible below floor-length skirt (rear shoe partly overlapped). Opaque dark green square-neck fitted noble gown/overdress over cream inner dress, gold knotwork woven borders, broad cloth belt with clasp, brooch-fastened patterned shoulder wrap resting along arms, restrained pendant. Plain stone doorway, no text/banner/headgear/armour/weapons. Fair freckled youthful face and natural medium feminine fullness.
